independentReview.fixedIssue: Trusted Pi internal target host was derived from a binding name and differed from the allowlisted host; forwarding now uses the fixed host constants and the test asserts destination-host equality.

acceptedProperties: A command intent is persisted before any project effect authorization.
Only the first accepted-to-dispatched transition can authorize execute.
Transport uncertainty and absent effects are observed under the same effectId and never auto-reexecuted.
Runtime receipts bind scope, turn, dispatch, command and effect before mutation.
Terminal command payloads are stripped while digest and bounded result evidence remain.
Trusted Pi and project Sandbox actor IDs are distinct deterministic full-SHA-256 derivations.
Trusted Pi outbound is restricted to two exact internal POST routes with rebuilt identity headers; project outbound is denied.
notAccepted: WorkspaceAgent alarm or TurnDispatcher production wiring
Project Sandbox effect executor or bash watchdog
real dual-Sandbox environment and image inspection
R2 Revision and Pi Session checkpoint
authenticated cloud SSE or user workbench flow
